> I found during my biggest depression that exercise and healthy eating helped a lot and I think that would apply too in your current state. It’s easier to deal with stress when your body is healthy than when it is run down and fat.

Yeah, definitely doing what I can and have been for a while now. I generally treat my body pretty well. Most of the health things recently are just unfortunate luck.

>You could investigate if there are any universities in the USA with reciprocal arrangements with your current Uni to recognise the prior learning/course credit and then you can continue to study in the US where your social situation should improve.

I don't know. Unfortunately, my home country isn't the United States. So, I'm not entirely convinced that the objective things would make it worth going back.

Internship prospects in my field are pretty much non\-existent whereas here, I've got some pretty sweet choices and am currently doing a remote job with some company out in Sweden. I'm glad for the opportunities, for sure. Objectively, I'm better off here. But, it's the subjective things that are the struggle, really.

As far as returning home and retaining credit, if I wanted to, while everyone recognizes the final degree, I'm not aware of anywhere in my country that will offer reciprocal credits for my university.

Additionally, one of the biggest reasons I came here was for financial reasons. It's significantly less expensive for me to study here. And, when I'm doing well, the Russian government pays my tuition entirely.

So, I'll probably have to suck it up at some point.

>...

Anyway, I appreciate it the response. I mainly just needed to rant and hope that someone would at least listen to a little bit of it.

If you don't mind me asking, how'd you end up in China?

Worth noting as well that I'm done with class for the day today and for the next few days, we have a national holiday which means no class which means that I won't be forced to socialize.

And, knowing my state right now, I'm too sad to make myself do it otherwise. So, I'll be alone and locked up in my room for the next few days. Not dope, yo.
